copy.curiosityHook: With an impossible deadline, zero outside help, and ruthless smugglers closing in, can scraps of a ruined transport actually take flight?
copy.description: After a violent sandstorm brings down their cargo plane in the Gobi Desert, a grounded crew of oil workers and a drifter must unite to rebuild the wreckage before dwindling supplies and desert marauders overwhelm them.
copy.vibeSummary: Exciting, suspenseful, and forward-moving survival drama with moderate emotional weight, ideal for an engaged group watch.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by John Moore, this fast-paced survival adventure delivers tense, high-stakes problem solving as desperate survivors race against unforgiving elements and hostile threats.

allowedMaterial: Capt. Frank Towns and co-pilot A.J. flying out of Mongolia
Cargo plane crash in the Gobi Desert after a sandstorm
Plan to rebuild the damaged aircraft to escape
Threats from dwindling supplies and smugglers
excludedMaterial: Whether the rebuilt aircraft successfully flies
Ultimate fate of the crew and passengers
